description: This file defines the internal class ClientProviderRuntime which implements the IProviderRuntime interface for client-side provider runtime functionality within the Orleans framework. It manages grain factory and client context, and provides extension binding capabilities.

classes.name: ClientProviderRuntime
classes.description: Implements IProviderRuntime for client-side provider runtime, managing grain factory, service provider, and extension binding.

methods.description: Constructor initializing the runtime with grain factory, service provider, and client context.

methods.description: Property returning the grain factory instance.
